discussion: Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/cis_2.3.14.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/cis_2.3.14.x/cis_2.3.14.1.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

odvs.description: win11cis_force_key_protection is the policy setting determines whether users' private keys (such as their S-MIME keys) require a password to be used. Configuring this setting to User must enter a password each time they use a key also conforms to the benchmark. The recommended state for this setting is: User is prompted when the key is first used. Note: Possible Valid Settings 1 - User is prompted when the key is first used 2 - User must enter a password each time they use a key
odvs.name: force_key_protection

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.14.1 | PATCH | Ensure 'System cryptography: Force strong key protection for user keys stored on the computer' is set to 'User is prompted when the key is first used' or higher"
  when: win11cis_rule_2_3_14_1
  tags:
    - level2-high-security-sensitive-data-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_2.3.14.1
  ansible.windows.win_regedit:
    path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Cryptography
    name: ForceKeyProtection
    data: "{{ win11cis_force_key_protection }}"
    type: dword
